scope: Reduce vault file-open overhead using transactional SQLite storage for new encrypted records; deploy and measure the installed hook
invariants: Keep DPAPI, category binding and token derivation unchanged
Read legacy record files without migrating or rewriting them
Store new payloads as encrypted SQLite BLOBs, never plaintext
Commit records before releasing protected results
Atomic insert and collision checks across concurrent hook processes
Close database connections at operation boundaries for Windows cleanup
Explicitly version the added storage layout; preserve recognized legacy vaults
Every supported output still runs rules and pseudonymization; Python remains rules-only
limitations: First unseen documents retain inference cost; measurements exclude model warmup and Claude network. No model or detector parameters changed.
